<br>
{{Cancelled Tournament|confirmed=true}}

The '''Mid-Season Invitational''' (MSI) features the winners from 12 individual Riot leagues spring splits competing in the 6th annual tournament.

'''On April 23, [http://www.riotgames.com/ Riot Games] announced that the MSI has been canceled due to the worldwide [[wikipedia:COVID-19|''Coronavirus'' epidemic]].'''<ref name="MSI canceled">{{cite web|url=https://watch.lolesports.com/article/update-on-msi-from-john-needham/blt26cfaff9e2c05782|title=Update on MSI from John Needham|date=2020-04-23|author=JOHN NEEDHAM|publisher=Riot Games|language={{Flag|usuk}}}}</ref> [[Mid-Season Cup/2020|Mid-Season Cup 2020]] was held for the [[LCK]] and [[LPL]] teams as a substitute for the cancelled MSI.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dailyesports.com/view.php?ud=2020051309090889903cf949c6b9_27|title='LoL 한중전' 미드 시즌 컵 5월말에 열린다|trans_title='LoL Korea vs. China' Mid-Season Cup will take place in late May|date=2020-05-13|author=남윤성|publisher=데일리e스포츠|language={{FlagNoLink|kr}} Korean}}</ref>
